title: Dev toolbar
description: Changes apply instantly, without a reload. Only fake data is stored, in this browser.
resetDone: Scenario reset to its starting data
templateReviewDone: Pending templates were approved or rejected
storageFull: Browser storage is full. Reset a scenario or delete snapshots to free space.
scenariosIntro: Each scenario is a seeded business with its own data, market and setup. Changes you make are kept per scenario until you reset.

A.purpose: The main demo and golden path. WhatsApp, web chat and email; English and Pidgin; AI live in Approve mode; salon pack installed.

B.purpose: Proves manual parity: no AI employee, email and web chat only, health gating on.

C.purpose: Proves market differences: UK formats, stricter consent and AI disclosure; AI in Suggest mode.

D.purpose: Proves SMS, strict consent and trial states. AI on during a trial.

E.purpose: Brand new account that just signed up. Empty states and onboarding.

F.purpose: Troubled account: past due, WhatsApp quality low, template rejected, calendar access expired, compliance blocking.

G.purpose: Agency with five client accounts and the workspace switcher. Arrives in a later step.
